findings.where: 1440 and 1280, every learner state, light and dark; 900 too (#exam beside #mist, #pace beside #score)
findings.what: Short cards hold a grid row open beside tall ones, so there are huge empty areas. getBoundingClientRect, gap under the short card: #exam (148–222px tall) next to #gain leaves 1,680–1,840px empty. #chal next to #study leaves 1,040–1,210px. #next next to #mist+#due leaves 850–1,460px (plan learner at 1440: 1,376px). #pace next to #score leaves 400–470px. #words next to #plan leaves 250–800px. At 900: #exam next to #mist leaves 380–680px and #pace next to #score leaves 520px.
findings.fix: At ≥1080, stack the 4-column cards in their own column instead of pairing them row by row. paintToday already moves nodes, so have it put #mist, #due, #exam, #pace, #chal and #words into an <aside class="td-side"> (display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px; grid-column:9/-1). Put #next, #gain, #score, #study and #plan into <div class="td-main"> (same flex column, grid-column:1/9). #hero, #qotd and #tests stay full width. Below 1080 give both wrappers display:contents so the phone order and the order rules still apply; J/K already sorts cards by their rects. At 760–1079, pair short cards with short cards (#exam with #pace, #mist with #score).

findings.where: All widths and themes. Every learner with 2+ due rows. After answering the day's questions, both slots add one.
findings.what: Up to 4 orange pills on one screen: Up next "Study 15 min", Due today "Start today", and "Now its twin" in each question-of-the-day slot (plan learner at 1440: [Study 15 min, Start today, Now its twin, Now its twin]). Decision 7 allows orange only for the one action that needs attention. "Start today" also repeats the first row's own Start button.
findings.fix: Keep .pill only on #sessStart (or the lead item). In dueBlock make "Start today" a .btn.sm (or drop it, since row 1's Start does the same). In paintAfter make "Now its twin" btn(), not pill().

findings.where: All widths and themes. New learner: "No streak yet", "0 min today". Plan and stretch learners: "Plan · 0 of 5 done" / "Plan · 0 of 4 done". Stretch: "SAT in 6 days" + "Final stretch · 6 days". After the exam: "Set your SAT date".
findings.what: The same defects the user named are still in the hero. "No streak yet" is a sentence where a number belongs (#5); the day's-questions head was changed to flame + number, the hero was not. "0 min today" and "Plan · 0 of 5 done" are the named "0 of 3 done" zero (#7). "6 days" appears in two adjacent chips (and a third time in the SAT card). After the exam the chip asks for a date while the SAT card says "Your SAT was Sep 27".
findings.fix: In heroChips: streak = flame + number with title="Study streak · best N", the same as .streak in #qotd. Hide the streak and minutes chips for a brand-new student until they have a value. Plan chip only when tasks_done > 0 (otherwise "Plan · 5 tasks" or none). Merge the stretch into the SAT chip ("SAT in 6 days · final stretch"). When ex.days < 0, show "SAT was Sep 27" → #exam.

findings.where: 1280 and 1440 (4-column card, ~300px), plan, stretch and after learners, light and dark
findings.what: The row body is only 103–132px wide because Start + ⋯ take 105px, so every row breaks. "11 due · ~10 / min · 11 / fading" runs to 3 lines with a line starting on "·". "4 questions · / ~6 min". The (i) icon wraps under its title ("Fix mistakes" and "The day's questions" at 1280: icon 20px below the title line). The head eyebrow "DUE TODAY · 1 OF 7 DONE · ABOUT 50 MIN / LEFT" wraps with an orphan.
findings.fix: At ≥1080: `#due .drow .dact .btn{min-height:32px;padding:0 10px;font-size:13px}` and move the ⋯ (.ibtn) into the .dt line so the body gets ~190px. Wrap each ' · ' part of .dm in <span style="white-space:nowrap"> so no line starts with '·'. Give .dt `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:nowrap` so (i) stays beside its title.

findings.where: All widths and themes, any learner with 30+ answers. The card is 1,840–1,930px tall at ≥1080 and 2,936–3,001px at 390.
findings.what: 19 rows, 16 of them "Not measured yet · about N of 44", each with two equal-weight buttons "Measure · 5" | "Learn it" that do different things and give no hint of the difference (the Study vs Learn it defect, #3). The default text is repeated 16 times (#7), and the card is the tallest on the page when it should be collapsed (#9).
findings.fix: By default show the measured rows (Top 6) and fold the rest into one row: "16 skills not measured yet · Measure all" with a ▸ that expands the list. In each unmeasured row keep "Measure · 5" as the .btn and make "Learn it" a .quiet link with title="A worked example, then 3 questions on this skill" (the same pattern as Up next's learn link). Remember the expanded state in localStorage the way satf.exam.open is.

findings.where: All widths and themes, every Not measured row (16 per page)
findings.what: The skill icon is not centred with its name. The glyph is 22px with vertical-align:baseline, so its centre sits 6px above the text centre (measured glyph_cy 2050 vs text_cy 2056, repeated on every row). This is the flame-not-centred defect again.
findings.fix: `.td .extra-row .line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}` and drop the ' ' text node in gainRow, or `.extra-row .glyph{vertical-align:-5px}`.

findings.where: All widths and themes. At 390 the title takes 2 lines and the streak drops to a third.
findings.what: The head is cluttered (#12): the title repeats the hero's date ("Questions of the day · Mon, Sep 28"), then a flame, then "0" or "1 day in a row", then a mono line "0 of 2 right this month · crowd 0%". "crowd 0%" appears when the crowd is only this student, and "0 of 2 right" is a zero (#7).
findings.fix: Title: "Questions of the day", with the date only when S.qday (a past day). Right side: flame + number only, with title="Day's questions streak · best N"; drop "… in a row". Move month and crowd into that tooltip or the Past days strip, show crowd only when crowd answered ≥ 5, and hide "N of M right" when N is 0.

findings.where: All widths and themes. New and mid learners (no sitting), and plan learners before a test.
findings.what: "No score yet" is set in DM Mono at 48px (40px on a phone), a sentence at number size. Around it, for a student with no score, sit: an empty 200–800 scale, "Not enough to project yet · 2 scored sittings in 60 days start it", "Where points went · Fewer than 5 misses in 14 days: nothing to sort yet", a help line, and two stacked equal buttons. The card is 440–590px of defaults.
findings.fix: When !sc and there is no added score: a .line "No score yet" at 15px and one btn "Get a score" (UI.menu: Module · 35 min / Diagnostic · 32 min / Add a score). Hide the scale unless there is a target or estimate, skip causesBlock when total < 5, skip the not_enough verdict until there is 1 sitting, and drop the help line (it becomes the menu's sub text).

findings.selector: #plan (planNone): hr.sep + p.k 'Study plan' + 'Build your study plan' + ol.cta-steps + ul + p.help + a 'Build my plan →'
findings.where: All widths and themes, any learner without a plan
findings.what: The card says its message twice (#9). First comes the full builder (Start from, SAT date, Daily, Days, Target, the week preview, Use this plan, Adjust…). Then a second block: "STUDY PLAN" (repeats the card title), "Build your study plan", 4 step links, 3 bullets, a help line and "Build my plan →", which goes to the same place as Adjust….
findings.fix: Keep the builder. Remove the second heading and the "Build my plan →" link (Adjust… already opens /plan/). Move the steps and bullets behind one quiet "How plans work" link, as a popover or tooltip, beside Adjust….

findings.selector: #next .lead (How did it go?) and #exam (Your SAT was …)
findings.where: The day after the exam (stage after), all widths and themes
findings.what: The same message and both buttons appear twice, in two stacked cards: Up next shows "How did it go? / Add your official score / Pick your next date", and the SAT card shows "Your SAT was Sep 27. / How did it go? / Add your official score / Pick your next date".
findings.fix: In paintExam, when mode === 'after', show only "Your SAT was Sep 27 · scores around <date>" with Remind me and the date trigger. The two actions stay in Up next's lead.

findings.selector: #mist > .acts (Start review · 10 min); #mist .acts (Fix all · N) inside tr.now + foot .acts (Fix all · N questions); #mist p.sub 'Rare skills · … · 0'
findings.where: All widths and themes. Mid, plan and stretch learners; the double Fix all and the empty rare group in the final stretch.
findings.what: Repeats and empties. "Start review · 10 min" duplicates Due today's "Review · 16 due · Start" row. In the stretch, the card has two Fix all buttons ("Fix all · 4" under Worth fixing now and "Fix all · 4 questions" at the foot). A "RARE SKILLS · AFTER OCT 4 · 0" heading with its help line is shown for zero rows.
findings.fix: Show one review start: drop it from Mistakes when t.due has a review row, or the other way round. In paintMist render the foot Fix all only when !(tr.now || tr.rare). Skip the rare block when !tr.rare.n.

findings.where: Plan and stretch learners. 1280/1440 (box 6px past the tile on each side). 390 (10px past; the text wraps to 2 lines and the boxes overlap the next tile; "Practice" breaks as "Practic / e").
findings.what: The quiet "Work ahead" keeps its -9px/-12px margins inside 43–87px tiles, so its box and focus ring spill onto the next tile (#4). At 390, .wk-s has overflow-wrap:anywhere, so the day word splits mid-word. In the stretch, the Sat Rest and Sun Exam tiles show "0q" plus "Work ahead".
findings.fix: `.wk-day .quiet{margin:0;padding:4px 2px;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;white-space:normal}`, or an icon button with aria-label. At ≤759 set `.wk-day .wk-s{overflow-wrap:normal;font-size:10px}`. In weekDay, show `${d.questions}q` and Work ahead only for kind practice/test with questions > 0 (not taper, eve, exam or rest).

findings.where: Plan and stretch learners, all widths and themes
findings.what: Raw slugs are shown to the student in mono: "Build · nonlinear_equations_and_systems, nonlinear_functions, linear_inequalities" and "Final · nonlinear_equations_and_systems, linear_equations_in_one_variable, …". It wraps with the last slug alone on a line.
findings.fix: In planSet: meta((w.theme||'').replace(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/g, x => UI.date(x)).replace(/[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)+/g, s => TOP(s))), in Archivo (see the mono finding).

findings.where: Plan and stretch learners on day 1, all widths and themes
findings.what: Four stat tiles of placeholders and zeros, with words in mono: "0% done / 0 of 30 study days", "On time / from your first study day", "Pace / needs +23 a week", "Day 1 of 41 / from the plan's start". The pager says "Week 1 of 6 · 0 of 25 tasks · 0%". The stretch shows "Week 1 of 1" with both arrows disabled.
findings.fix: Show a tile only when it has a value (done > 0, on_time.of > 0, made_per_week known). On day 1, collapse to one Archivo line: "Day 1 of 41 · needs +23 a week". Drop "· 0 of N tasks · 0%" while it is 0, and hide ‹ › when weeks.length === 1.

findings.selector: #due .drow .dm ('0 of 2'), .dt ('Sweep · 0 of 3 fixed mistakes today'), #due p.sub (Plan · 0 of 5 · …), .due-head .k + .meta
findings.where: All widths and themes: every learner who hasn't answered today; plan and stretch learners
findings.what: Zeros, and one idea given several numbers. "The day's questions 0 of 2" is the named "0 of 22" defect; nz() deliberately keeps "0 of". A row title reads "Sweep · 0 of 3 fixed mistakes today". The plan sub says "PLAN · 0 OF 5 · 20 MIN LEFT OF 30" (the hero repeats 0 of 5). Today's minutes appear as "about 50 min left" (head), "30 min over your goal", "20 min left of 30" (sub) and "Today in your plan · 30 min" (Up next).
findings.fix: In nz(), drop "0 of N" parts too, and show pl(of,'question') while have is 0 (the code already does this for progress). Build the Sweep title without the 0 count. Show the minutes once: in Due today's head ("about 50 min"), with "over your goal" as its title tooltip. Remove the counts from the plan sub and the Up next head meta.

findings.where: 900, 1280 and 1440, all learners, both themes
findings.what: The calendar uses less than half its card. The grid has fixed 40px columns (7×40 + 6×4 = 304px) inside a 584–643px card, leaving ~280–340px empty to the right of the month (#10: a strip of 7 tiles with half the width empty). The day detail sits under it with the right half blank.
findings.fix: `#study .cal-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(40px,1fr));max-width:560px}` `#study .cal-d{width:auto;aspect-ratio:1.3}`. Or at ≥1080 use `.cal-wrap{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);align-items:start}` so the day detail is the caption beside the month it describes, top-aligned with the grid.

findings.selector: #next .go > button.quiet (New to X? See an example first), #next .go > a.quiet (Or start from a score: …)
findings.where: 390 (new and stretch learners); focus overlap also at 1280/1440
findings.what: Both long quiet offers wrap to 2 lines as centred text: "…See an example / first" with the orphan centred, and "…20 questions · / 32 min". Their boxes sit 3px apart, so each focus ring covers the other and the Study pill.
findings.fix: `.td .go .quiet{text-align:left}`. At ≤759 `.td .go{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;row-gap:16px}`. Shorten to "See an example first" (the topic is on the chip, keep it in title) and "Diagnostic instead · 32 min".

findings.card: pace, gain, mist, study, tests (new student)
findings.selector: #pace > p.line, #gain > p.line + .acts, #mist (No open mistakes + help + Practice), #study .cal-wrap, #tests .acts
findings.where: Brand-new learner, all widths and themes
findings.what: For a brand-new student, most cards are made of zeros and defaults. Pace: "… · 0 so far" + Timed set. Points: "Answer 30 questions … · 0 of 30" + "Start the coach's set" (a second 'start a set' right under Up next's). Mistakes: "No open mistakes." + a help paragraph + a Practice link back to #next. Study: a full empty month + a mono note. Recent tests: "No tests yet." + Module and Section buttons that repeat the Score card's.
findings.fix: For a learner with d.total === 0, render each of these as its head plus one quiet line without the count ("Shows after 20 timed answers"; "Shows after 30 answers"). Drop the duplicate start buttons (Up next owns starting) and keep them in each card's ⋯ menu or as quiet links. Skip the empty calendar until the first active day (the line above it already says so).

findings.where: All widths, keyboard focus, both themes
findings.what: Hover no longer paints, but the focus ring still draws around the padded box and covers neighbours (#4). Measured overlaps: All words → Start 8px; Add a score → Section button 8px; +2 more → Fix all 8px; Report a problem → Share 8px; Open plan / Change plan / Add to calendar onto each other 8px; Add your name → h1 6px; Relapsed · learn it again over the topic line, the Sure tag and Try one now; Target 650 needs… → the summary line 7px; Adjust… → its help; Build my plan → → its help 9px.
findings.fix: In ui.css: `.quiet:focus-visible{outline-offset:-6px}`, so the ring sits inside the padding (3px above and below the text, 6px to each side). In index.html: `.td :is(.acts,.go,.card-act,.sess-ctl,.q1-after,.tm){column-gap:16px}`, so a quiet link beside a control keeps its own space.

findings.where: All widths and themes
findings.what: A toggle and a navigation link share one row (#2). "More options" (a link to /practice) sits 14px after the Untimed | Timed seg at the same weight, so it reads as a third clock option.
findings.fix: Move More options to the .go row after the Study pill (or into the card head as a quiet link), so the clock row holds only the clock.

findings.where: 760 and up, all learners, both themes
findings.what: Controls on one row have different heights: the size seg track is 42px (its buttons are forced to 36px), the chips beside it are 36px (dh 6), and the clock seg below is 40px. The two stacked segs differ by 2px, and the selected looks differ (seg: paper with orange ring; chip: wash-2 with orange ring).
findings.fix: Drop `.size .seg button{min-height:36px}` so both segs are 40px, and set `.td .size-picks .chips > button{min-height:40px}`. Use one selected look for this row: the chips' wash-2 + ring, or paper + ring on both.

findings.selector: #sessBody > p.meta (15 min · about 11 questions at your pace), #sessStart, #next .card-head .meta (Today in your plan · 30 min)
findings.where: All widths and themes, all learners
findings.what: The chosen size is said three times: the selected chip "15", the meta "15 min · about 11 questions at your pace", and the pill "Study 15 min" (#6). With a plan, the head says "Today in your plan · 30 min" while the session defaults to 15.
findings.fix: In paintBlocks, box mode: meta = "about 11 questions at your pace" only. Keep the pill's size or make it "Study". When a plan day exists, default SZ.sel to pday.minutes (nearest box option), or drop the head meta (Due today carries the minutes).

findings.where: 1280 and 1440, mid and plan learners, both themes
findings.what: The columns shift from row to row because the last column (.skill-side) is auto-width: "≈ +10" sits at x=514, 534 and 529 on consecutive rows, the track starts at 616, 636 and 631, and track widths are 150, 204 and 198. The number column zig-zags down the card. "Learning 54% right of / 11" wraps with the count alone.
findings.fix: `.td .skill-row.gain{grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,1fr) 84px minmax(150px,1.2fr) 150px}` (or subgrid on .gain-rows), and `.skill-m .meta{white-space:nowrap}`.

findings.where: All widths and themes
findings.what: A help paragraph sits beside a link (#13): "Estimated with our score model: how far your Math band would move if this skill reached 80%." at 12.5px next to "How this works" at 14.5px, with centres 3px apart. It wraps under the button at 390.
findings.fix: Keep only the "How this works" link and put the sentence in its title, or UI.fact(link, 'points') as receiptBlock does for How.

findings.selector: #mist p.help (Blind spots / Rare skills / new-student), #score p.help, #chal > p.line.soft, #plan p.help, #study > p.meta (Nothing to review yet…)
findings.where: All widths and themes
findings.what: Help paragraphs sit permanently where a tooltip or link would do (#13): "You were sure and wrong: these never get double-checked." (orphan "double-checked."); "About 0.5 of 44 a test each: after the SAT, or now if you have time."; "Any module, the diagnostic, or an added score gives a score."; the challenge's 2-line rules; "About a minute. Change it any time. Free, as many as you like."; "Nothing to review yet · first check-ins come 3 days after a fix."
findings.fix: Put each sentence in a title/aria-describedby on its sub heading or button (a small (i) like .why-i on Due today), or in UI.fact popovers. The challenge rules become the Start button's title; the head keeps "10 questions · 16 min".

findings.selector: #mist .trow .tm (meta ×N, pips, glyph + topic in .meta, .tag.ink Sure, button.quiet Relapsed · learn it again, .btn Try one now)
findings.where: 1280/1440 (4-column card) and 390, both themes
findings.what: A cluttered meta row (#12): mono count, pips, a glyph, the topic name in DM Mono, an 11px Sure tag, a 14.5px quiet link and a 40px button wrap onto 3 lines (centres 473, 499, 535). Tag and link sizes don't match (11 vs 14.5px), and the topic is a word set in mono.
findings.fix: Line 1: ×N · pips · glyph + topic in Archivo 13px soft (`.trow .tm .meta{font-family:var(--font)}`). Line 2: actions at one size: Sure as a 16px icon with title, "Learn it again" as a 13px quiet link, and Try one now as .btn.sm.

findings.where: All widths and themes, any learner with mistakes
findings.what: The spacing rhythm breaks: 0px between the "Start review · 10 min" button and the next heading ("BLIND SPOTS · 3" / "WORTH FIXING NOW") because `.sub:first-child{margin-top:0}` fires inside the list div. There is also 0px between the big "7 OPEN" and its meta line, which wraps with "fixed" alone ("6 fixed today · 5 new today · 4 half / fixed").
findings.fix: `#mist > .acts + div{margin-top:18px}` and `#mist .mist-fig + .meta{margin-top:4px}`. Shorten the meta to what needs attention ("6 fixed today · 5 new"; half-fixed goes in the tooltip).

findings.where: Stretch (6 days) at 1280/1440 and exam day, both themes
findings.what: The card is collapsed (Details), but the 7–10-item checklist stays open below the summary: 330–480px at full card width, with labels ending at 441px of a 908px list (467px empty to the right). "TEST-DAY CHECKLIST · 0 OF 7" is a zero. On exam day the key fact ("Doors close at 8:00 AM") is hidden inside Details while the checklist shows.
findings.fix: `@media (min-width:760px){#exam .check-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}`. Collapse the checklist to its heading line with ▸ (open by default only when days ≤ 1), show the count only once something is ticked, and put "Doors close at 8:00 AM" in .exam-sum on exam day.

findings.where: ≥1080, both themes; any learner (unanswered and answered)
findings.what: The two slot tiles are forced to the same height, leaving a large blank area in the shorter one (#10): the MC slot's content ends 224px above its bottom (354 of 578px). After answering, the grid-in slot has 279px blank (843 of 1122px).
findings.fix: `.qd-row{align-items:start}`.

findings.selector: #qotd .qd-after .acts (pill, 5 more like this, More hard · …, Save, Share, quiet Report a problem)
findings.where: After answering, 1440 (each slot ~450px) and 390, both themes
findings.what: Six actions of mixed weight wrap onto 3 rows, with "Report a problem" alone on the last one. "Save" and "Share" are equal .btn next to practice actions, with no hint of what they do. In the answered MC review the student's pick appears three times: the option marked YOUR ANSWER, the line "Your pick · B · −8/5 · Solved for the wrong sign of x", and YOUR ANSWER / CORRECT ANSWER boxes, plus the trap line a second time. "You're one of the first 1 today".
findings.fix: Keep Now its twin (as .btn, see the orange finding), 5 more like this and Harder. Put Save, Share and Report into one ⋯ UI.menu. In qotd's review, hide the verdict's answer boxes when the options already carry the marks. For c.answered === 1 say "You're the first today".

findings.selector: #qotd p.k.qd-rowk (MATH) + .qd-lab .k (MATH · MULTIPLE CHOICE / MATH · GRID-IN) + the question's Grid-in chip
findings.where: ≥1080 (row label) and all widths (slot label), both themes
findings.what: "Math" is said twice: the row label "MATH", then each slot "MATH · MULTIPLE CHOICE". The grid-in slot also shows a "Grid-in" chip under its "GRID-IN" label.
findings.fix: Slot label = "Multiple choice" / "Grid-in" (drop the subject while the row label or tab shows it), and hide the format chip in qotd workspaces.

findings.selector: #study .figs .fig (Today / This week / This month / Active days this month)
findings.where: All widths and themes, mid, plan and stretch learners
findings.what: "Today 8m" and "This week 8m" repeat each other on Monday. Tile meta is mono and runs to 3–4 lines ("8 questions · / 38% right · 6 / fixed · of 30m"). "ACTIVE DAYS THIS MONTH" wraps with MONTH alone. All four tiles are stretched to 135–167px, so the Month and Active tiles are half empty.
findings.fix: Hide This week while it equals Today. Put the Today meta in Archivo on at most 2 lines, or move it into the bar4 title. Label the last tile "Active days" (the month is the tile before). `.figs{align-items:start}`.

findings.where: All widths and themes, mid and plan learners (today selected)
findings.what: Repeats. For today, the caption "Mon, Sep 28 · 10m · 8 questions · 38% right" repeats the Today tile word for word. One sitting prints "4:21 AM – 4:21 AM". The footer "3-day study streak · best 3 · goal met 0 of the last 14 days" repeats the hero chip and adds a zero.
findings.fix: When day === today, the caption drops the minutes, questions and % (the tiles say them) and keeps sittings, mistakes and topics. Print one time when first_at and last_at are the same minute. Footer: drop the streak and best, and drop "goal met" while it is 0.

findings.where: All widths and themes, mid and plan learners
findings.what: Each stacked bar says its numbers three times: on-bar labels "Traps 12 | Gaps 5", the legend "Traps 12 · Gaps 5", then "Most of your misses are traps (12 of 17)". The time split does the same ("Algebra 7 min", legend "Algebra 7 min · Advanced Math 1 min", "83% of your time on Algebra"). The small segment's label is clipped to nothing (scrollWidth > clientWidth).
findings.fix: Call UI.stackBar with the legend off when segments are labelled, and let the legend carry only segments too narrow for their label. The sentence keeps the insight without repeating the count ("Most of your misses are traps: fixing them is your fastest gain").

findings.where: All widths and themes, any learner without a plan
findings.what: The builder's two-column grid is misaligned. The Daily select (48px) and the Days buttons (40px) share a row, with bottoms 8px apart. In row 1 the Start-from slider sits 18px lower than the SAT date select because of the "Your best guess · not set" line. Selected days are solid ink (#3F3F3F) while every other toggle on the page is paper/wash with an orange ring. "not set" in mono sits beside a slider thumb resting at 500.
findings.fix: Match heights with `.days7 button{min-height:48px}` (or the selects .sm at 40px). Put "Your best guess" in the label line and hide "not set". `.days7 button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--wash-2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--amber);color:var(--ink)}`.

findings.selector: #plan .card-head .card-act (a.quiet Open plan, a.quiet Change plan, button.quiet Add to calendar)
findings.where: Plan and stretch learners. All widths; at 390 the three wrap under the title.
findings.what: A cluttered head (#12): three quiet links 8px apart, whose focus rings overlap each other by 8px. "Add to calendar" also sits in the SAT card's details.
findings.fix: Keep "Open plan" in the head and move Change plan and Add to calendar into a ⋯ UI.menu (.ibtn) beside it.

findings.where: All widths and themes, without a plan. At 390 Adjust… wraps alone.
findings.what: One row mixes a disabled orange pill (15.5px, 52px), a 12.5px help line "Pick where you start" and a 14.5px quiet (18px height difference). At 390 "Adjust…" wraps onto its own line.
findings.fix: Put the help under the pill (display:block, as the field hint), or drop it and say it in the pill's title. Move Adjust… to the card head's right.

findings.where: All widths and themes (new and mid learners)
findings.what: The same actions carry different labels, and two equal buttons don't say how they differ (#3). The diagnostic is "Diagnostic · 20 questions · 32 min" (Score and Up next) and "Diagnostic · 20 q · ~30 min" (Plan). The module is "Module · 22 questions · 35 min" (Score and Tests), "Take a module · 35 min" (Plan) and "Module · 22 q · 35 min". In Score the two buttons each wrap to their own line at span-6 width.
findings.fix: Use one label per action everywhere (e.g. "Module · 35 min", "Diagnostic · 32 min") and a title for the difference ("a timed test module" vs "20 questions across every skill"). In Score use one "Get a score" menu (see the score finding).

findings.where: All widths and themes
findings.what: Mono is used for sentences, against "DM Mono only for numbers that matter": "Today in your plan · 30 min", "15 min · about 11 questions at your pace", "from 48 answers · updated after every answer", "6 fixed today · 5 new today · 4 half fixed", "Evidence: Algebra 23 · Advanced Math 14 (thin)", "Nobody has finished today's yet.", "from the plan's start", "Plan: partial", "Night before / Test day", and topic names in Mistakes rows. That is 91 mono text nodes on one screen.

findings.where: 1440, plan learner, light
findings.what: About 48 distinct size/weight/family combinations on one page: sans at 11, 11.5, 12, 12.5, 13, 13.5, 14, 14.5, 15, 15.5, 16, 17, 18, 20 and 36px, mono at 10.5, 11, 12.5, 13, 18, 24, 44 and 48px. Decision 7 asks for few text sizes and weights.

findings.where: All widths and themes
findings.what: Card heads are inconsistent. 13 cards render their h2 as 18px 700 Archivo in ALL CAPS grey, because the .k eyebrow class brings uppercase and --soft ("UP NEXT" reads as "UPNEXT", and "QUESTIONS OF THE DAY · MON, SEP 28" wraps at 390). Due today, now its own card, has a 10.5px DM Mono eyebrow head that wraps at 4-column width.

findings.where: ≥760 when the student has no name (new, mid, stretch and after learners), both themes
findings.what: The chips are aligned to the bottom of the left block (the "Add your name" line), so their centre sits 27px below the title's centre (h1 cy 147, chips cy 174). With a name they line up with the title (cy 67 vs 70), so the head changes shape between students.

findings.where: All widths, both themes
findings.what: The quiet's -12px margin puts its box 12px left of the page gutter (the hero has no padding). Its focus ring reaches 16px out, 4px from the screen edge at 390, and covers the h1's descenders by 6px.

findings.where: All widths, keyboard focus
findings.what: Focus rings on segmented options and calendar days are 2px wide at a 2px offset, with only 2–4px between items, so each ring covers the neighbouring option or day by 2px.
findings.fix: `.seg:where([role]) > button:focus-visible, .cal-d:focus-visible{outline-offset:-2px}`.

findings.where: 1280/1440 (4-column card), new and mid learners
findings.what: The four date buttons wrap into a ragged 2×2 (widths 94, 97, 97 and 135px). "Sat, Mar 6, 2027" is wider, so the rows don't line up, and "Another date" hangs under them.
findings.fix: `#exam > .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}` with the buttons at width:100%.

findings.where: 390, any learner without a plan
findings.what: The first-week rows are ragged: some wrap to put the date on its own line and the text below (Mon, Tue, Thu), while others fit on one line (Wed, Fri, Sat).
findings.fix: `.week-rows li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:88px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 10px}`, so the text wraps inside its own column.

findings.where: 390, both themes
findings.what: The equation breaks in the middle of an expression: "… = 8/(x" on one line and "– 14)" on the next.
findings.fix: `#qotd .q-stem .tex, #qotd .q-stem .katex{white-space:nowrap}` for inline math, or insert break opportunities only after '=' and between terms.

findings.where: Dark theme, all widths
findings.what: In dark mode ink fills turn near-white (#ECE8E1), so the Sure tags and the stack bar's second segment (a ~150px bright bar) are the brightest things on the page, louder than the orange.
findings.fix: In the dark tokens, give these fills var(--mat) or var(--tile-2) with --ink text instead of inverted ink.

findings.where: ≥1080 after answering, on page load
findings.what: The answered verdicts replay their rise fade on every repaint (the cached paint, then the live one). A capture 2.5s after load still showed the grid-in verdict at opacity 0.57, so it looks disabled while it plays.
findings.fix: In paintQotd, skip the rise for slots already answered when painting (add a class that sets animation:none on .verdict when the verdict is restored, not new).

findings.where: All widths, local time 04:21
findings.what: It says "Good evening" at 4 AM, because the code sends every hour before 5 to evening.
findings.fix: In paintHero: hr < 5 → 'Good night' or 'Hello'.

findings.where: 1440/1280/900/390, light+dark, every learner with 30+ answers (used, plan, fin, exam, after)
findings.what: The Grid-in answers and Pace rows print the literal text "[object Object]" under their names. gainRow passes s.detail, an object like {spr:.579, mcq:.739, per_test:12}, or {} for Pace, straight to meta() (index.html:1498).
findings.fix: In gainRow's extra branch, format the detail first: const d = s.detail || {}; const det = typeof d === 'string' ? d : s.kind === 'spr' && d.spr !== undefined ? join(`grid-ins ${pct(d.spr)} right`, d.mcq !== undefined && `multiple choice ${pct(d.mcq)}`, d.per_test && `about ${d.per_test} of 44`) : ''; then use det ? meta(det) : null. Pace ({}) shows no line.

findings.card: Grid (Up next, SAT, Pace, Daily challenge, Words)
findings.where: 1440 and 1280, light+dark, every learner that has mistakes or a plan; 900 for #exam/#pace
findings.what: Very large empty areas, measured. At 1440: Up next has 996px empty below it (plan), 1621px (fin) and about 1000px (used), because it spans two rows beside Mistakes plus Due today. The SAT card has 2184px empty below it beside the 20-row Points list. Daily challenge has 1140px empty beside Study time, Pace 470px beside Score, and Words 294px beside Your plan. At 1280 Up next has 1117px empty and SAT 2208px.
findings.fix: Stop coupling row heights. At >=1080, paintToday puts the sections into bands, each a 2-column grid (8fr/4fr) whose columns are flex stacks: band A is [#next, #gain] | [#mist, #due, #exam]; band B is #qotd, full width; band C is [#score, #study, #plan] | [#pace, #chal, #words]; band D is #tests, full width. Drop '#next { grid-row: span 2 }' (index.html:42). The phone DOM order stays as it is.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, every learner; the header wraps to 3 lines at 1280/1440 in the side column (fin: 'DUE TODAY · 1 OF 7 DONE · ABOUT 51 / MIN LEFT' then '24 min over your goal')
findings.what: This card's title is a 10.5px DM Mono all-caps eyebrow with three counts crammed in ('DUE TODAY · 6 PARTS · ABOUT 68 MIN'), plus a second mono line ('41 min over your goal'). Every other card has an 18px Archivo h2. This is the cluttered header the user flagged, and the header is not an h2, so J/K and Enter skip it.
findings.fix: Build the head with head('due', 'Due today', startBtn), like the other cards. Keep one fact as a right-side meta in Archivo: 'about 68 min', or 'about 26 min left' once something is done. Drop 'N parts' (the rows show it) and 'N of M done' (the checkmarks show it). Move 'over your goal' / 'fits in your goal' into the title attribute of that meta.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, every learner (new: 'Study 15 min' vs 'Start today'; plan: 'Study 30 min' vs 'Start today'; exam day: 'Start' vs 'Start today')
findings.what: There are two orange primaries next to each other that do different things: one starts the coach's set, the other starts the first due row (Review or the day's questions), and nothing hints at the difference. For the used learner, 'Start today' is the same action as the Review row's Start and as Mistakes' 'Start review · 10 min'.
findings.fix: Keep Up next as the only .pill. In dueBlock, render the Due button as btn('Start: ' + (undone[0].title), ...) with class btn sm, or drop it because every row has its own Start. When a plan exists, have Up next lead with the plan's first undone task, so the page has one primary.

findings.card: Hero / Up next / Due today / Study time
findings.where: 1440/1280/900/390, plan and fin learners
findings.what: The day's minutes are said six ways, and they don't agree. For the plan learner: hero chip '18 of 45 min today', brief 'Since Sat: 17 of 45 min', Up next head 'Today in your plan · 45 min', Due 'ABOUT 68 MIN' plus '41 min over your goal', plan sub 'PLAN · 0 OF 4 · 27 MIN LEFT OF 45', Study 'Goal 45 min ✎' plus tile 'of 45m'. Fin shows 'about 51 min left', '9 min left of 27' and '24 min over'. A student cannot tell how much is left.
findings.fix: One number per idea. The hero chip keeps 'N of goal min today'. Up next drops its right meta whenever #due has rows (paintNext's `right`). The Due head shows one 'about N min left'. dueBlock's plan sub becomes just 'Plan' with no count or minutes. The Study today tile drops 'of 45m' (the head button already says the goal).

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, every learner
findings.what: '15 min' appears three times in one block: the selected chip '15', the meta '15 min · about 9 questions at your pace' and the pill 'Study 15 min'. This is the oversized-primary-repeating-facts kind the user flagged (in count mode: 'Study · 10 questions' plus meta '10 questions · 16 min').
findings.fix: pillLabel(): the box label is just 'Study' (keep 'Keep going' / 'Practice anyway' as they are). paintBlocks est: in box mode show only `about ${q} questions at your pace`; in count mode only `~${m} min`. Each fact then appears once.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, plan and fin learners
findings.what: Zeros and placeholders fill the plan. Tiles read '0% done / 0 of 36 study days', 'On time / from your first study day' (a placeholder word) and 'Pace / needs +19 a week' (the word 'Pace' as a value). Fin shows 'On time 0 of 1'. The pager reads 'Week 2 of 8 · 0 of 19 tasks · 0%', the hero chip 'Plan · 0 of 4 done' and the Due sub 'PLAN · 0 OF 4'. This is the '0 of 3 done' kind the user flagged.
findings.fix: planSet: render the % tile only when c.study_days_done > 0 and the On-time tile only when c.on_time.of > 0. The pace tile shows the verdict word only when made_per_week is known; otherwise one tile 'Needs +19 a week'. Pager: `Week ${w.n} of ${weeks.length} · ${pl(w.tasks_planned,'task')}`, adding 'N done' only when > 0. heroChips: `Plan · ${pl(tasks_counted,'task')} today` while tasks_done is 0. dueBlock sub: 'Plan'.

findings.selector: #plan .wk-strip + .meta, i.e. the theme line under the pager bar
findings.where: All widths, light+dark, plan and fin learners
findings.what: The week theme shows raw topic slugs in mono: 'Build · linear_functions, area_and_volume, linear_equations_in_one_variable · Test Oct 2'. Fin shows 'Final · area_and_volume, …'.
findings.fix: In planSet (index.html:2193), map the slugs: meta((w.theme||'').replace(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/g, x => UI.date(x)).replace(/\b[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)+\b/g, TOP)). Better still, have the server send w.topics and the UI render TOP() names.

findings.where: 1440/1280/900/390, light+dark, plan and fin
findings.what: The 'Work ahead' quiet buttons break out of their tiles and sit across the tile's bottom edge. Their -12px margins overlap the next tile's button (168px² each, measured). At 390 the status word breaks mid-word ('Practic / e') because of overflow-wrap:anywhere.
findings.fix: Add .wk-day .quiet { margin: 0; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 12px; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.2 }. Change the 390 rule to .wk-day .wk-s { overflow-wrap: normal; font-size: 10px }. At <760, render Work ahead as an icon button (+) with aria-label and title 'Work ahead'.

findings.where: 1440 and 390, light, any learner who met the daily goal (used learner with goal 15)
findings.what: The 'How' quiet button's -12px margin pulls it over the last word of the sentence, so the line reads '…the mistakes it opened are in FiHow ⓘ'. This is the hover/negative-margin overlap kind the user flagged.
findings.fix: Add .receipt .quiet { margin: 0 0 0 6px; padding: 0 } (or build 'How' with link(..., 'plain')). The fact (i) that UI.fact appends follows with its own 4px gap.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, every learner with 30+ answers (14 rows each)
findings.what: There are 14 rows of 'Not measured yet · about 4.6 of 44', each with two equal-weight buttons, 'Measure · 5' and 'Learn it', that do different things with no hint of the difference. That is exactly the Study vs Learn it pattern the user flagged, and 'Not measured yet' repeats on every row. The card runs to about 3000px at 1440.
findings.fix: In paintGain, group the unmeasured skills under one sub: sub(`Not measured yet · ${k}`). Each row shows its name plus 'about 4.6 of 44' and one btn 'Measure · 5'. 'Learn it' becomes a quiet with title 'A worked example, then 3 questions'. Collapse 'The other N' (and the unmeasured group) behind a 'Show N more' quiet by default.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, all learners
findings.what: DM Mono carries sentences and words, not numbers that matter. Examples: '15 min · about 9 questions at your pace', 'from 42 answers · updated after every answer', 'Nothing to review yet · first check-ins come 3 days after a fix.', 'Nobody has finished today’s yet.', 'not set', 'Set a start to see the pace', 'Not measured yet · …', 'Evidence: Algebra 11 (thin) · …', 'Plan: partial', 'Night before', 'Today in your plan', the Study tile labels 'TODAY / THIS WEEK' and their 4-line sub-sentences, plan tiles 'On time' / 'Pace' at 18px mono, and 'No score yet' at 48px mono.
findings.fix: Scope to Today: .td .meta { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: 0 }, and .td :is(.fig .k, .qd-rowk, .qd-lab .k, .qd-past > .k, .mist-fig .k) { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: .06em }. Wrap real figures in <span class="mono"> where they matter (blocks .qm, fig .v numbers). Render 'No score yet' as a .line rather than .score-band.

findings.card: After the SAT: Up next + SAT + hero
findings.where: All widths, light+dark, the day after the exam (after learner)
findings.what: The SAT card repeats Up next's message and buttons word for word: 'How did it go? · Add your official score · Pick your next date'. On the same screen the hero chip says 'Set your SAT date' although the date is set (it has just passed), a third name for the same action.
findings.fix: paintExam's after-branch keeps only the date trigger and 'Scores come out around … · Remind me'; the two buttons live in Up next only. In heroChips, show no SAT chip when ex.days < 0 (Up next leads with it). If a chip is kept, label it 'Pick your next date' and wire it to examPop.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, exam learner (SAT today, before 1 PM) and after learner
findings.what: On exam day the summary says only 'Today'; 'Doors close at 8:00 AM' is hidden behind Details. The page still offers orange 'Start today' on Review, the day's questions and the challenge, 'Build a plan to set a daily goal', the 20-row Points list, and the plan builder preselecting today's date 'Mon, Sep 28'. The day after, the builder preselects the past 'Sun, Sep 27', and both show 'Pick a date and your days to see the first week.'
findings.fix: paintExam: when days === 0, sum = 'Today · doors close 8:00 AM'. When stageMode() === 'exam', dueBlock renders no Start today and no build-a-plan link, and paintGain / planNone render collapsed (head row plus a 'Show' quiet). planNone preselects the first date later than today (dates.find(d => d.day > today())).

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, all learners; at 390 the title wraps to 2 lines and the flame sits on a 3rd
findings.what: Crammed header. The flame, '2 days in a row' (Archivo 14) and '0 of 4 right this month · crowd 0%' (mono 13) sit in one line beside the title, and they show a zero and a meaningless 'crowd 0%'. The qotd streak uses the same flame as the study streak (hero chip and phone top bar), so a new student sees '🔥 0' twice plus 'No streak yet', for two different streaks.
findings.fix: metaT: include mo.of only when mo.right > 0, and crowd only when mo.crowd_pct > 0 and the crowd has at least 5 answers. Move both into the streak's title tooltip. Give the qotd streak its own glyph (e.g. a calendar-check) or the label 'Daily questions · N days', with no flame.

findings.selector: .hero-stats a:first-child ('No streak yet'), .hero-stats a:nth-child(2) ('0 min today')
findings.where: All widths, light+dark, brand-new learner
findings.what: The first chip is a sentence where a number belongs ('No streak yet'); the phone top bar shows '🔥 0' for the same fact. The second chip is a bare zero ('0 min today').
findings.fix: heroChips: the streak chip renders flame + number the same way as the bar (`${d.streak}`, with 'best N' only when best > streak). Hide the minutes chip while st.today is 0 and there is no goal; with a goal, show it once there is at least 1 minute.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, every learner before answering the day's questions
findings.what: The row reads '0 of 2', the '0 of 22' kind the user flagged. nz() deliberately keeps '0 of N' (index.html:390), and the server's r.meta wins over the progress fallback.
findings.fix: Change nz to drop any part starting with 0: filter(x => !/^0\b/.test(x.trim())). In dueRow use const m = nz(r.meta) || join(!(done && r.result) && pg, r.minutes && `~${n(r.minutes)} min`); pg already gives '2 questions' when have is 0.

findings.where: 1440/1280/900/390, light+dark, fin learner (SAT in 6 days)
findings.what: '6 days' appears three times in the first screen: chip 'SAT in 6 days', chip 'Final stretch · 6 days' and SAT card '6 days'. At 390 the hero stacks 5 chips over 3 rows, a slogan line and the brief. The expanded 7-item checklist then pushes Up next to y≈950 at 390 and y=690 at 1440.
findings.fix: heroChips: merge the two into one bold chip, 'Final stretch · SAT in 6 days'. paintExam: the checklist renders collapsed into one row, 'Test-day checklist ▸' (with 'N of 7' once at least 1 is checked, open state kept like satf.exam.open), and expands by default only when days <= 1.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, used/plan/fin learners
findings.what: '17m · 12 questions · 58% right' appears four times on one screen: hero chip, Today tile, day detail title and 'This week vs last'. On a Monday the Today and This week tiles both say '17m'. The streak ('1-day study streak · best 2') appears in both the hero chip and the Study meta, and 'best 3' shows even when it equals the streak.
findings.fix: dayDetail: leave the detail unopened while the selected day is today (the tile says it), and show it on pick. Hide the This week tile when st.week === st.today. The Study meta drops the streak (the hero has it) and shows 'goal met N of 14' only when N > 0. The hero drops 'best' unless best > streak (already the case); apply the same rule in Study.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, used/plan/fin/exam/after
findings.what: Review is offered three times: Mistakes 'Start review · 10 min', the Due row 'Review · Start' and 'Start today' (which starts the same thing). The Due row meta says the same number twice: '13 due · ~10 min · 13 fading'.
findings.fix: paintMist: when S.t.due.rows has a review row, drop the Start review button (keep rv.due as a quiet link '13 due ↓' to #due). Server meta (api_today.py:789): list only the non-zero parts and omit 'N due' when it equals a single part, giving '13 fading · ~10 min'.

findings.card: Up next / Score / Study plan / Recent tests
findings.where: All widths, light+dark, new/used learners (no score, no tests)
findings.what: The Diagnostic is offered three times with different numbers ('20 questions · 32 min' in Up next and Score, '20 q · ~30 min' in the plan builder). The module is offered three times ('Module · 22 questions · 35 min' in Score and Recent tests, 'Take a module · 35 min' in the plan). A new student sees about 20 start buttons in total.
findings.fix: Use one label constant for each test type. Score keeps the Module and Diagnostic buttons. Up next's 'Or start from a score…' link goes (Score is on the page). Empty Recent tests shows 'No tests yet' plus a quiet 'Add a score' only. planNone uses the same 'Diagnostic · 20 questions · 32 min'.

findings.selector: #plan (planNone): .sub 'Build with these', hr.sep + .k 'Study plan' + CTA block
findings.where: All widths, light+dark, new/used/exam/after learners
findings.what: One tall card holds two ways to build a plan: the inline builder with 'Use this plan', and the CTA with 4 step links, 3 bullets, a help line and 'Build my plan →'. 'Study plan' is said three times (card title, eyebrow, headline). The builder also presents defaults as if the student had chosen them: SAT date 'Sat, Oct 3' while the SAT card asks 'When is your SAT?', days 'Mon Wed Fri Sat', and 'Your best guess · not set'.
findings.fix: Drop the hr/eyebrow/headline/bullets. Keep one quiet link, 'Step by step →' (/plan/), with the bullets as its title. The SAT date select starts on a disabled 'Pick a date' option when profile.exam_date is null, and the preview waits for a date. The best-guess value renders only after the slider moves.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, every learner without a sitting (all six seeds)
findings.what: 'No score yet' is set at 48px mono, a sentence where a number belongs. For the plan learner the estimate 520 sits under it as small text ('Your estimate: 520'). Below that: an empty 200–800 scale, 'Where points went · Fewer than 5 misses…: nothing to sort yet', 'Not enough to project yet · 2 scored sittings in 60 days start it', a help sentence, and a mono 'Evidence: Algebra 11 (thin) · Advanced Math 4 (thin) · …' repeating '(thin)' four times.
findings.fix: When there is no sitting: show '≈ 520' in .score-band with the meta 'your estimate' if p.current exists; otherwise a normal .line 'No score yet'. Render the scale only when there is a band, target or estimate. Skip causesBlock when c.total < 5, and skip the not_enough verdict when there are no sittings. Evidence becomes one line, 'Thin in 4 domains', next to Sharpen, with the per-domain counts in its title.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, brand-new learner
findings.what: Under the one-line empty state, the card still paints a full empty month, the Minutes/Questions/Accuracy/Fixed switch, the Less–More legend, and a mono sentence about review check-ins that belongs to Mistakes.
findings.fix: When `fresh`, render the line plus a quiet 'Show calendar' that reveals .cal-wrap. Drop the 'Nothing to review yet…' line (Mistakes owns review; if it is kept, it goes in the Mistakes (i) tooltip).

findings.where: 1440/1280/900, light+dark; worst for the new learner (16 empty tiles) and for the plan learner (13 of 14 empty)
findings.what: The strip fills its width with the last 30 days, even days before the student ever visited, so a new student sees a row of 16 empty '○○' tiles: defaults on screen.
findings.fix: In pastStrip, start `days` at the later of (t0 − 30) and the learner's first day (min(d.past[].day) or S.cal.first_active). If there are no past days, render only 'Past days' plus 'Older…'. Fade tiles with no marks (opacity .5) so the answered days stand out.

findings.where: Title at all widths; 'Math' row label at >=1080; tab + label at <1080
findings.what: Repeats. The title date 'Mon, Sep 28' repeats the hero eyebrow 'MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 28'. 'Math' is said three times (the row label 'MATH' plus each slot's 'MATH · MULTIPLE CHOICE' / 'MATH · GRID-IN'). The grid-in slot says 'Grid-in' twice (the label and the 'Grid-in' tag). On phones the tab 'MC' is repeated by the label 'MULTIPLE CHOICE'.
findings.fix: Title 'Questions of the day', adding the date only when S.qday is a past day. Hide .qd-rowk when only one subject has slots. The slot label shows just the format ('Multiple choice' / 'Grid-in') and is hidden under 1080 (the tab names it). Pass hideSkill or a no-format-tag option to UI.workspace for qotd.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, after answering today's question (used learner)
findings.what: The action row holds 6 buttons of equal weight after the pill: 'Now its twin', '5 more like this', 'More hard · Nonlinear equations', 'Save', 'Share', 'Report a problem'. The two practice buttons look identical with no hint of how they differ. With both slots answered at >=1080, two orange 'Now its twin' pills sit side by side. The crowd line reads 'You’re one of the first 1 today'.
findings.fix: Only the first wrong slot gets the pill; the other becomes a btn. Merge '5 more like this' and 'Harder · X' into one btn, '5 more like this', with a ⋯ choice for harder. Put Save, Share and Report into a ⋯ menu (UI.menu.bind). Crowd line: c.answered <= 1 ? 'You’re the first today' : `One of the first ${c.answered} today`.

findings.selector: #qotd .qd-slot .q-* verdict boxes ('YOUR ANSWER' / 'CORRECT ANSWER') + option reason lines
findings.where: 1440, light (used learner after answering)
findings.what: One panel states the pick and its mistake three times: the 'YOUR ANSWER' tag on option B, 'Your pick · B · −8/5 · Solved for the wrong sign of x', and then the boxes 'YOUR ANSWER B · −8/5 | CORRECT ANSWER C · 8/5' followed by '● Solved for the wrong sign of x'. 'Why each wrong answer is wrong ⌄' labels reasons that are already shown under every option.
findings.fix: In question.js review mode (the shared rule, so fix it once): when MCQ option marks are shown, skip the Your/Correct answer boxes (keep them for SPR) and skip the repeated trap line. Hide the 'Why each wrong answer is wrong' toggle when prefs.open_explanations is true.

findings.where: All widths, light+dark, goal met (used learner)
findings.what: The receipt is a long always-open block. 'Moved: Area & volume Not started → Learning · Nonlinear equations Not started → Learning · …' runs 2 lines. findings.where: 1440/1280 (12-column grid) and 900 (2-column grid), all states with data
findings.what: Each tall card is paired with a short card on the same grid row, which leaves large holes. mid at 1440: Points (1843px) beside SAT (221px) leaves about 1600px empty. Study time (1193) beside Challenge (210) leaves 980px. Plan (921) beside Words (156) leaves 765px. Score (589) beside Pace (156) leaves 430px. At 900: Mistakes (733) beside SAT (221) and Score (714) beside Pace (177) leave about 520px each.

At 760px and up, emulate masonry: set #today { grid-auto-rows: 8px; row-gap: 0; grid-auto-flow: row dense } and give each section margin-bottom: 20px. A ResizeObserver on each section then sets el.style.gridRowEnd = 'span ' + Math.ceil((el.offsetHeight + 20) / 8). Keep the column spans; SAT, Pace, Challenge and Words then fill the holes.

findings.where: Every student with 30+ answers; 1843px tall at 1440, 2801–2915px (3.4 screens) at 390; light+dark
findings.what: The card lists all 26 skills. 22 of them read 'Not measured yet · about 3.2 of 44', each with its own text line and two equal buttons side by side, [Measure · 5] [Learn it], which do different things with no hint of the difference. This is the Study vs Learn it problem again, plus a Why-style line under every row and a tall list of defaults. It adds 40 Tab stops, and on a phone Mistakes starts at y≈4900 after this card.
findings.fix: By default show the measured rows (UI.skillRow) plus the top 3. Fold the unmeasured skills into one collapsed row, '22 skills not measured yet · Measure all · 5 each', which expands to the full list. In that list keep [Measure · 5] as the only button and make Learn a quiet 'Learn' with title 'A worked example, then 3 questions' (or put it in a ⋯ menu). Drop the per-row 'Not measured yet' line (the group header says it once) and show 'about 3 of 44' as the row's right-hand number, rounded. On phones, move #mist before #gain in paintToday.

findings.where: All widths with a hover pointer (1440/1280/900), every learner, on load
findings.what: The grid-in answer field takes focus on page load (question.js:765 autofocus with preventScroll), even though it sits off-screen at y=3583. The first Tab goes to 'Entry rules' deep in the card and skips the skip link, hero, Up next and Due today. Pressing J (the page's 'Next card' shortcut) types 'j' into the field and jumps the page 2725px down.
findings.fix: Pass autofocus: false in both UI.workspace calls in slotPanel(), and in paintQ1() for Up next's first question. The field then takes focus only when the student taps or tabs to it.

findings.where: First screen at 1440 for a new student (with the banner's Sign in, three orange pills); on a phone the two pills are one card apart; plan: 'Study 30 min' vs 'Start today'; after: 'Add your official score' vs 'Start today'
findings.what: Two orange primaries of equal weight do different jobs. Study starts the coach's set; Start today starts the first undone Due row (for a new student it only scrolls to #qotd). With a plan, the plan's tasks are under Start today while Up next pushes a different session. Neither label says what it will start.
findings.fix: Use one primary per screen. When Due today has undone rows, its start is the orange pill and names the task, for example 'Start: Review · 10 min' or 'Start: The day's questions', built from undone[0].title and minutes. Up next's Study then renders as .btn, as the hasLead branch already does. With no undone rows, Study stays the pill.

findings.where: All learners, all widths, light+dark
findings.what: Zeros on screen. The day's-questions row reads '0 of 2': the server sends meta '0 of 2' (api_today.py:834), the client prefers r.meta, and nz() keeps '0 of'. Hero chips show 'Plan · 0 of 4 done' (plan), 'No streak yet' as a sentence where a number belongs, and '0 min today' (new).
findings.fix: In dueRow, set const m = ((r.progress && r.progress.of && !r.progress.have) ? null : r.meta) || join(...), so the row reads '2 questions'. The plan chip shows only once tasks_done > 0, otherwise 'Plan · 4 tasks today'. The streak chip becomes the flame plus a number (same markup as .streak in #qotd), and the min-today chip is hidden while st.today is 0 and there is no goal.

findings.where: Plan student, all widths, light+dark
findings.what: Raw slugs are shown to the student: 'Build · area_and_volume, right_triangles_and_trigonometry, lines_angles_and_triangles', in mono and wrapping over three lines on a phone.

findings.where: Every student without a scored sitting; at 900 it wraps to two lines ('No score / yet')
findings.what: 'No score yet' is set in the 48px DM Mono number face: a sentence where a number belongs, and the largest text on the page.
findings.fix: With no score, render no .score-band. Put 'No score yet' as one soft .line, followed by the Module / Diagnostic buttons (or show the estimate as the band when p.current exists). Keep .score-band for real numbers only.

findings.selector: #hero .brief, #mist .meta + .acts ('Start review · 10 min' · '2 due today'), #due Review row .dm

Review is also startable from two cards, and the two cards give different 'due' numbers (27 vs 2).
findings.fix: When #due has a review row: Mistakes drops the Start review row and the 'check-ins due' part of its meta; the hero brief drops the check-in fact; the Review row's meta reads '2 check-ins · ~10 min', with '27 due · 25 fading' moved into its (i).
